summary: Completed a bounded exact-EXE instruction-alignment proof for guarded-GF target C's first outbound CALL. Exact GitHub CI verifies the manually reviewed prefix from 0x65970 is contiguous and byte-identical, the existing function-start heuristic resolves to 0x65970, and the E8 at 0x65997 is instruction-aligned and decodes to 0x28460 in .text. The later raw candidates 0x659AC and 0x659C1 remain unresolved; helper semantics and ScreenHud ownership are not inferred.
